title: Research: reusable clean checkpoint lowers weighted binary leaf bill 20 to 16 (no new kappa)
body:
For four ordered complete signed-leaf prices `(1,3,1,1)` and two scratch arrays, reusing one initially clean array across successive subtrees lowers the exact weighted leaf bill from **20 to 16**, with the same twelve leaf calls and full dirty restoration. An interval dynamic program optimizes this explicitly defined ordered binary/reserved-connector class. The uniform 54-factor fixture remains **2112**, matching PR714. **Status: recursive-interface research; no new kappa.**

The changed four-factor word adds one internal dispatch. The complete local charges are `16+g_D+4g_C+12g_L` versus `20+3g_D+g_C+12g_L`, so the gain survives only when `3g_C-2g_D<4`, before any differing routing or preparation bill. Prices are abstract positive integer interface inputs, not measured PR628 supplier costs. This is not a practical speedup or a new supplier.

Reproduce with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python -I -O -B research/reusable-clean-checkpoint/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_REUSABLE_CLEAN_CHECKPOINT 516 census cases; 1016 basis cases; weighted 20 -> 16; uniform54 2112; no new kappa`.

Validation includes an independent exhaustive decorated-tree census for all `{1,3}` price vectors through six factors and all caps 1 through n-1; every admissible tree through five factors; complete noncommutative basis, exact inverse and nonlinear restoration tests; eight mutation/admission controls; isolated optimized and relocated replay; certificate and source corruption rejection. Actual pinned PR714 code reproduces the uniform count. The selected-record checker passed on a complete clean checkout of the same base. No supplier cold replay, root-wide suite, PR628 rounded numerical leaf replay, remote CI, Linux or Lean pass is claimed.

Only `research/reusable-clean-checkpoint/` is added, with written class-specific proof, complete work/storage/conditional precision recurrence, exact witnesses, source pins, validation and local claim. Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`; OS assignment seed **54**. No pinned coordination issue was found. Overlap refreshed through PR779. PR714 (`efad8a40094ab453c0525efef0b0eff2a5d8b850`) fixes the clean connector at the root; PR730/744/758 study all-dirty classes. The present extension changes clean-array lifetime across sequential subtrees, not the selected frontier.

Credit FanPUYen/PR714, chafreaky/PR628, 0xkilgore/PR663, androolloyd/PR673 and concurrent Sagar Thakrar, Ali Romman and Koroffstrogov, with original predecessor notice retained and three exact source files vendored unchanged. Prepared for **nightangelflowerwin-ops** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. No priority or independent human-review claim. Clean-array provisioning, actual unequal prices, all-size compilation, precision, routing, physical hosting and analytic transfer remain obligations. `upstream/` and the selected result are untouched.
